messages:
Maya: FYI — noticed a spike in auth failures during BYOK imports to staging, kicked off vuln triage. @oncall please ack.

hsm-bot: Alert: 3 failed key-wrapping attempts from import-worker-2 within 2 minutes. Link: https://alerts.local/613579

Sam: oncall here. Can you paste the error snippet? Also, did we roll the RBAC change last night?

Maya: Error in logs: "wrap_key: HSM_UNAUTHORIZED: key_acl_blocked". Saw role=importer-service@infra. We tightened RBAC at 01:12 UTC last night.

Juan: That was me — I tightened importer-service so it can't call WrapKey without explicit 'wrap' permission. Goal was to reduce operator blast radius. Maybe shipped too strict for staging import flow.

Lee: If import fails we fallback to proxy-wrap (less desirable). We should check audit logs and KMS proxy traces. Does KMS show a NAIVE fallback in traces?

Maya: I pulled HSM audit: entries show client_cert=thumbprint=AB:CD:... op=WrapKey result=DENIED. Then a later process attempted proxy-kms and succeeded.

Sam: Can we confirm no plaintext key material persisted on import-worker pods? @Juan can you run a quick grep and memory scan?

Juan: Quick grep: no temp files under /tmp. But logs show `temp_key_material` env var present for ~10s during import. I'll do a deeper process memory check and scrub if needed.

Maya: Question: for BYOK customer imports, what's our custody boundary? Legal previously said customer retains custody until wrap under customer's CMK — but do we ever proxy-wrap on our side in staging?

Lee: Compliance note — customers expect key material not accessible to Redwood. Our intended flow: import-worker sends directly to HSM proxy, HSM wraps under customer CMK, we do not persist plaintext. Staging maybe has dev flags that enabled proxy fallback.

Sam: Suggestion: add an explicit guard in import path to fail unless `REDWOOD_ALLOW_PROXY_WRAP=true`. Also tag audits with `import_path=byok-v2` and `env=staging` for easier queries.

Maya: Also need an RBAC change request to revert importer-service to allow wrap for staging only, not prod. Can we do a canary with namespace label `env=staging`?

Juan: I'll create a scoped role `importer-wrap-staging` and bind it to the staging namespace only. PR incoming for k8s Role + RoleBinding.

Maya: For vuln triage status: severity=medium until we confirm no exfil. Assign to Sam + Juan. Target: investigate + patch in 2 hours, escalate to incident report if needed.

Sam: Ack. Starting memory/process dumps and audit-log correlation now. Will post hashes and timelines.

hsm-bot: IncidentLog: created incident INC-2026-613579 - assignees: Sam, Juan. https://incidents.local/INC-2026-613579

Lee: If any customer CMK wrap failed we should pause onboarding and notify legal + CS.

Maya: I'll draft a short notification template for CS/legal and link it here in 1h.

Sam: Quick dev note — adding env var scrubber to import-worker image; pushing image sha: sha256:abc123def456... will update when staged.

Juan: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/importer/pulls/42 — includes role, rolebinding, and audit tag changes. @Maya please review the policy doc attached in the PR.

Maya: Reviewing now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Lee: Please update the incident ticket with final audit artifacts and close the loop when done.
